description: This file defines template classes for managing web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, with support for file handling, hashing, and request/response management within a web framework.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a single element instance with reference counting, providing access via the Element() method.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including methods for collecting info, uploading, and downloading files, with internal state management and request handling.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests for file storage and retrieval, with authorization and hash validation.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: A nested class within ClientTransferType that manages the link, request, and response lifecycle for a transfer channel.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request, opening the link if necessary.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the transfer channel and releases resources.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Prepares and sends a HEAD request to gather information about a remote resource.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a specified destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a local destination, with optional starting position.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Abstract method to set up connection parameters, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Callback invoked when info collection completes.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Callback invoked when a transfer completes.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Abstract method for authorizing requests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Handles attaching a body to incoming requests.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming requests and prepares responses.

methods.name: EndTransfer
methods.description: Handles cleanup after a transfer completes, including hash validation and file info loading.

methods.name: _CalculateHash
methods.description: Calculates hash of the file content for request signing.

methods.name: _ValidateHash
methods.description: Validates the hash signature of a response or request.

methods.name: _LoadHash
methods.description: Loads hash context from the file.
